changes.rationale: 删除内核开发演进，保留可操作的自动设备说明。
changes.before_excerpt: 当 `device="auto"` 时，statgpu 可以根据后端可用性和工作量特征自动选择执行位置。具体的切换阈值属于性能调优参数，因此可能随着内核实现和硬件支持改进而变化。
changes.after_excerpt: 当 `device="auto"` 时，后端选择可能取决于可用性与工作量。应用需要固定后端时，请显式设置设备，并检查该估计器的设备限制。

changes.rationale: 删除面向基础设施维护者的规范；前文 Cox 统计说明与链接已足够。
changes.before_excerpt: 这体现了更一般的设计原则：共享的 CV 基础设施不应为了强行统一实现而抹掉各模型特有的统计结构。

changes.rationale: 删除重复的编辑放置规则。
changes.before_excerpt: 仓库内部的调用关系、私有缓存约定、启发式阈值以及验证证据仍放在 `dev/` 下，不属于本公开设计页。

changes.rationale: 以限定范围的实际 CV 错误行为与例外导航替代开发者许可措辞。
changes.before_excerpt: 当用户显式指定 `device="cpu"`、`"cuda"` 或 `"torch"` 时，估计器按照公开的后端约定执行；如果对应的加速器路径不可用或该组合不受支持，会直接报错。CV 加速不能仅因为 CPU 路径更容易执行，就把显式 GPU 请求静默改成 CPU 拟合。
changes.after_excerpt: 使用 `device="cpu"`、`"cuda"` 或 `"torch"` 请求特定执行后端。专用线性模型 CV 估计器会拒绝不可用的显式加速器请求。设备行为取决于具体估计器；需要确定执行位置时，请查阅[设备与 GPU 内存](device-and-memory.md)，并注意其中的核方法与样条例外。

changes.rationale: 以支持检查操作和可核实的限制代替普遍性失败规范。
changes.before_excerpt: 具体归一化方式由对应估计器和损失函数的约定决定。任何加速路径只有在保持同一权重约定时才是等价的。不支持带权目标的组合应明确报告限制，而不是静默丢弃权重。
changes.after_excerpt: 具体归一化方式与带权组合支持范围取决于估计器和损失函数。拟合前请检查模型的权重支持；例如，惩罚 Cox CV 不接受 `sample_weight`。

changes.rationale: 删除对假想替代方案的编辑评价，保留推断条件限制。
changes.before_excerpt: 这样可以避免为每个临时的折内拟合发布没有实际意义的系数推断结果。同时也意味着，普通 CV 后得到的置信区间和 p 值通常应解释为**以已经选定的调参配置为条件**的结果；除非某一种具体推断方法明确校正了调参或模型选择带来的额外不确定性。
changes.after_excerpt: 普通 CV 后得到的置信区间和 p 值通常应解释为**以已经选定的调参配置为条件**的结果；除非某一种具体推断方法明确校正了调参或模型选择带来的额外不确定性。

device/shared-routing.finding: Explicit shared device settings select NumPy/CuPy CUDA/Torch CUDA; unavailable explicit CuPy/Torch CUDA raise. Array conversion enforces the explicit estimator GPU paths. Runtime CPU-host checks verified unavailable GPU errors for Ridge.

device/ridge-cpu.finding: Ridge forwards device and cleanup controls; explicit CPU exact branch uses NumPy. Both bilingual example blocks executed on CPU successfully.

device/global-policy.finding: Global auto resolves CuPy then Torch CUDA then CPU; setting an unavailable explicit GPU warns and retains it. get_device resolves auto, not the raw configured policy. 12 enum-resolution combinations verified with original state restored.

device/penalized-auto.finding: Automatic CPU/workload dispatch tests estimator _device == AUTO rather than the global unresolved policy. Thus a global GPU setting does not universally ensure GPU placement when the model device remains auto. Private threshold values are deliberately excluded from the guide.

device/functional-torch.finding: Explicit backend torch with device cpu selects Torch CPU; device auto selects Torch CUDA when available otherwise Torch CPU. This differs from shared estimator device torch.

device/smoothing.finding: Explicit backend overrides device. cuda/auto may fall from unavailable CuPy to available Torch CUDA. Torch array creation without ref_arr does not set CUDA, so CPU tensors/NumPy input can remain CPU under normal Torch default CPU. This is source-traced, not physical GPU evidence.

device/spline.finding: Backend detection gives native tensor types priority, and spline _prepare_X uses the supplied Torch tensor as reference. Existing Torch CPU tensor is preserved despite requested GPU; NumPy input attempts the requested accelerator.

device/kernel-features.finding: Shared Torch availability check precedes xp_asarray without target reference. Feature outputs can remain CPU; public fitted arrays are converted to NumPy. Five documented CPU alternatives executed successfully.

device/input-output.finding: Formula construction uses Patsy/DataFrame and NumPy; shared conversion moves inputs; Ridge prediction defaults to host NumPy and return_cpu=False preserves fitted backend while public coefficients are host arrays.

device/cleanup.finding: Ridge default is False; cleanup calls pool free/empty-cache under the enabled flag without clearing fitted data. Live allocations are not reclaimable cache; cleanup does not reduce the allocations necessary to complete fitting. Timing/deduplication varies across estimator transactions, so no universal cleanup boundary is promised.

device/solver-link.finding: Existing compatibility/algorithm targets retained; no support rows or solver claims changed by this worker.
